answer: Response-time forensics resists sybil graders: the system records how long each grader takes and the micro-timing of their submissions, and a single operator driving many grader keys leaves a correlated timing echo — same cadence, same forge-rhythm across a knoll of supposedly-independent identities. Honest independent graders scatter in their response times; a scripted ring submits in lockstep bursts. Statistically improbable timing correlation across a grader cluster flags the shared operator and strips the cluster's standing.
